summary: Rank blocks and per-GPU worker row slices rebase CSR delimiters to their own nonzero ranges. Each worker pre-captures GRAPH_BATCH launches when iterations permit, replays the graph floor(iterations/GRAPH_BATCH) times, then issues scalar launches until its counter reaches iterations. Thus graph batching plus remainder preserves requested launch count; SASS variants are selected by average row length and each processes full CSR rows. Worker synchronizes after output copies.

source_evidence.claim: Per-worker row/nnz setup, graph capture of fixed launch batch, timed graph/remainder loops and output copies.

compiled_evidence.claim: The clocked main function launches the timed outlined worker and gathers results before the end clock. Untimed graph capture has an actual 32-launch host backedge. The complete timed worker retains graph replays with increments of 32, scalar remainder launches for all six group-size dispatches, output copies and synchronization.
